description.en: Reported the initial voltage unchanged, forgetting that it decays exponentially over time.
description.et: Esitas algpinge muutumatuna, unustades, et see kahaneb aja jooksul eksponentsiaalselt.

description.en: Subtracted t/(RC) from one instead of using it as the exponent of e.
description.et: Lahutas t/(RC) ühest, selle asemel et kasutada seda arvu e astendajana.

description.en: Used RC as the exponent directly instead of t/RC, ignoring the elapsed time.
description.et: Kasutas astendajana otse RC, mitte t/RC, eirates möödunud aega.
